title: Health Psychology & Wellness
summary: Health psychology: biopsychosocial model, health behavior, stress and coping, wellness, mindfulness, and psychological factors in illness.
revision: Health psychology: biopsychosocial model, health behavior, stress and coping, wellness, mindfulness.
traps: Health psychology = psychological factors in health/illness.
Biopsychosocial: biological, psychological, social factors interact.

notes.t: The study of psychological and behavioral processes in health, illness, and healthcare.
Model proposing that health and illness result from the interaction of biological, psychological, and social factors.

i: Health behavior: actions affecting health (exercise, diet, sleep)
Stress and health: stress effects on immune system
Health promotion: preventing illness, promoting wellness

notes.t: Paying attention to the present moment non-judgmentally, used for stress reduction and wellness.
UGC NET may ask about the biopsychosocial model, health behavior, and stress-coping.

mnemonics.title: BCS
mnemonics.text: B — Biological factors (genetics, physiology), C — Cognitive/psychological factors (beliefs, emotions), S — Social factors (culture, family, support)

flashcards.a: Psychological and behavioral processes in health and illness.
Bio + psycho + social factors affect health.
